channel.title: Small Steps — journal
channel.description: Notes on recovery without streaks, points or guilt — one small step a day.

item.title: Why streaks hurt recovery (and what helps instead)
item.description: Streak mechanics are great for habits — and quietly cruel for anyone recovering from burnout or illness. Here's the psychology, and the alternative.

item.title: The smallest step counts: a field guide to tiny wins
item.description: Got out of bed. Drank water. Replied to one email. Why naming tiny wins out loud rewires how a hard season feels.

item.title: Returning after long sick leave: a pace-first guide
item.description: The world expects you to be 'back' on day one. Your energy disagrees. Here's how to structure a return that doesn't re-break you.
